summary.text: Drew MacEwen is a Republican member of the Washington State Senate from District 35, which he has represented since January 9, 2023, and he is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Carolina Mejia (D).
He is a U.S. Navy veteran whose career experience includes the investment business, and he served in the Washington House of Representatives from 2013 to 2023.

paragraphs.text: MacEwen served in the U.S. Navy from 1992 to 1998.
He earned a high school diploma from Sheboygan Falls High in 1992 and bachelor's degrees from the State University of New York, Albany, and Excelsior College in 1997.
MacEwen represented House District 35-Position 2 from 2013 to 2023, when Travis Couture (R) succeeded him, and then took the Senate seat held by Tim Sheldon.

In the 2023-2024 session he served on the Business, Financial Services & Trade; Environment, Energy & Technology; Labor, Commerce & Tribal Affairs; Senate Transportation; and Economic Development & International Relations committees.
